mutations.name: a reversed cue range stays reversed
kills: emphasis mapping contract orders a cue range whose until word comes before its at word

mutations.name: a span overlaps a cue that ends before it starts
kills: emphasis mapping contract maps a word span over words between the cues to the targets it covers

mutations.name: a time span drops the word that starts on its first second
kills: emphasis mapping contract maps a time span to targets through the beat's word timings

mutations.name: a time span over no word yields a range
kills: emphasis mapping contract maps a time span that covers no spoken word to no target
